name: Mered
title: The Descendant of Judah
summary: Mered was a man from the tribe of Judah, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He is known for having married Bithiah, a daughter of Pharaoh, which is remarkable because it shows a connection between the tribe of Judah and the Egyptian royal house. His lineage is noted in the genealogies of 1 Chron. 4.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Mered is mentioned as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles, placing him within an important tribal lineage.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Bithiah, Pharaoh's daughter
keyEvents.description: Mered married Bithiah, who was a daughter of Pharaoh in Egypt. This marriage represents an unusual connection between the Israelite tribe of Judah and Egyptian royalty.

keyEvents.title: His descendants through Bithiah
keyEvents.description: Through Bithiah, Mered had children who founded several cities and families in Judah. Among his descendants are mentioned the founders of Gedor, Sokoh, and Zanoah.

keyEvents.title: His Jewish wife and her descendants
keyEvents.description: Mered also had a Jewish wife who bore Jered, father of Gedor; Heber, father of Sokoh; and Jekuthiel, father of Zanoah. These descendants became important in the tribal territory of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mered's place in Ezra's lineage
keyEvents.description: Mered is recorded as a son of Ezra (not the well-known scribe Ezra) in the genealogy, linking him to a specific branch of the tribe of Judah.
